title: 16502 - 16502/P0118/000280
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Difficulties with starting a cold engine.
Starting the engine when engine is warmish or warm, idle rpm immediately is 1200 - 3000 rpm.
With all engine temperatures idle rpm will often vary between 900 - 1000 rpm.
With engine warm (90 °C) the engine temperature suddenly drops (70 °C) and slowly comes back to 90 °C.
Diesel Engines: Glow plug indicator may be on for a longer than normal time or at ambient temperatures where it shouldn't come on at all.
commonCauses: The electrical signal coming from G62 is Çok Düşük (Basınç Kaybı)
Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or connections faulty (short circuit?)
Engine Coolant Temperature Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G62) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  / Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Engine Coolant Temperature Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G62)
technicalNotes: In many cars between MY 1995-2002 the G2/G62 had a bad reputation for failing often. The original G2/G62 sensor is black and the improved replacements are green.
